## Definition of Done
- [ ] Requirement IDs referenced in code and PR
- [ ] ADR written and accepted for any choice among alternatives; index updated
- [ ] Tool inventory updated for any new/changed dependency
- [ ] Feature doc updated
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated
- [ ] CONTEXT.md updated for new terms
- [ ] Plain-English decision record updated if a decision changed
- [ ] Tests written; golden results updated if outputs changed
- [ ] Benchmarks recorded if performance is claimed
- [ ] Privacy check done; no identities; no geometry or location in logs
- [ ] "As of" and completeness present on any new output
- [ ] Assistant: prompt versioned, evaluation run recorded (if touched)
- [ ] Data: provenance record present (if touched)
